topic: Switching off from work is a skill (single)
caption:
Switching off from work is something people can practise, not a fixed part of who they are.

In research with employees, programs that taught boundaries between work and home, ways to manage emotions and better sleep helped people switch off, on average. The programs were tested with working adults in general, not people with clinical burnout. A small end-of-work ritual, like writing tomorrow's to-do list, is one place to start.
